import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int h = sc.nextInt();
        int n = sc.nextInt();

        int moves = 0;
        int leftLimit = 1;
        int rightLimit = (int) Math.pow(2, h);
        int currentHeight = h;
        String currentDir = "L";

        for (int i = 0; i < h; i++) {
            double midPoint = (leftLimit + rightLimit) / 2.0;
            if (currentDir.equals("L")) {
                if (n > midPoint) {
                    moves += calculate(currentHeight) + 1;
                    leftLimit = (int) midPoint + 1;
                } else if (n < midPoint) {
                    int sum = (leftLimit + rightLimit);
                    int adjustment = (sum % 2 != 0) ? 1 : 0;
                    rightLimit = (int) midPoint + adjustment - 1;
                    moves += 1;
                    currentDir = "R";
                }
                currentHeight -= 1;
            } else {
                if (n < midPoint) {
                    int sum = (leftLimit + rightLimit);
                    int adjustment = (sum % 2 != 0) ? 1 : 0;
                    rightLimit = (int) midPoint + adjustment - 1;
                    moves += calculate(currentHeight) + 1;
                } else if (n > midPoint) {
                    moves += 1;
                    leftLimit = (int) midPoint + 1;
                    currentDir = "L";
                }
                currentHeight -= 1;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(moves);
        sc.close();
    }

    private static int calculate(int n) {
        int[] cache = new int[n + 1];
        cache[0] = 1;
        int total = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            cache[i] = cache[i - 1] * 2;
            total += cache[i - 1];
        }
        return total;
    }
}
